_comment: Serving shim for vLLM: transformers does not know model_type deepseek_v41 (the real checkpoint config.json), so vLLM gets this llama-shaped config via --hf-config-path (dims from the checkpoint). The TT model class reads the real checkpoint itself (DSV41_CKPT) and ignores this file apart from the dims vLLM sizes its scheduler with. The checkpoint's fp8/fp4 quantization_config is deliberately absent: the weights are loaded by tt/loader.py, not by vLLM. It also carries the checkpoint's vision_config / image_token_id: the multimodal processor (tt/vision_vllm.py) reads them (no checkpoint access in the frontend process).
